response: These messages are sent to both blackboards to communicate with other sites and coordinate source assignments. By sharing tentative machine->source choices, sites can work together to minimize main-grid usage and optimize renewable energy utilization.

These function calls post a message to the blackboards indicating the tentative assignment of machines to shared renewable sources. The message is the same for both blackboards, as the goal is to minimize main-grid usage and stay within capacity for all sources. 

Please note that the actual assignment of machines to sources will be done in the Execution Phase using the `assign_source` function. The Planning Phase is used for discussion and coordination only.

These function calls will post a message to both blackboards, communicating the tentative assignments of machines to sources. This allows for coordination with other sites and helps to minimize overflow by sharing information about planned assignments.

These function calls will post a message to the other agents on blackboard 2 and blackboard 3, informing them of the tentative assignments for the machines under Delta Homes' control. This will facilitate discussion and coordination among the agents to minimize main-grid usage.

These function calls will post the message "I plan to assign my machines to the following sources: CNC mill to src_Geothermal, EV charger to src_Solar, Server rack to src_Biomass, EV charger to src_Geothermal, Kiln to src_Biomass, HVAC unit to src_Solar. Please let me know your tentative assignments." to blackboard 1 and blackboard 2, respectively. This will allow the agent to communicate its tentative machine->source choices to other agents on the blackboards.

These function calls will post the message "I plan to assign my machines to the following sources: HVAC unit to src_Geothermal, Water heater to src_Solar, Refrigeration chain to src_Wind. Please let me know your tentative assignments." to both blackboard 0 and blackboard 1, allowing the agent to communicate its tentative machine->source choices with other agents on both blackboards.
